# Test results (generated by scripts/make_results.py)

Test split: 5500 questions, 1000 out of scope. Paired stratified bootstrap, 2000 resamples.

## Pre-registered claims (TEST_PLAN.md)

| # | Claim | Difference in AUROC [95% CI] | Success rule | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | The flow teacher beats the GMM | +0.024 [+0.013, +0.035] | lower bound > 0 | **pass** |
| C2 | The 2-jump student keeps the teacher's accuracy | +0.005 [+0.002, +0.009] | interval inside ±0.01 | **pass** |
| C3 | The 2-jump student beats the GMM | +0.030 [+0.019, +0.040] | point estimate > 0 | **pass** |
| C4 | Learning the paths matters (flow map vs one-shot regressor, same data) | +0.034 [+0.026, +0.042] | lower bound > 0 | **pass** |
| C5 | Speed (ms per query, 1 CPU thread) | student 0.84 ms vs teacher 12.9 ms (2 steps) and 283 ms (32 steps) | reported | 15× and 338× faster |

## Main results

| Method | Test AUROC | ms per query |
|---|---|---|
| Gaussian (one bell curve) | 0.788 | – |
| Top-1 cosine (RAG default) | 0.832 | 2.74 |
| GMM-150 ratio (strongest label-free baseline) | 0.876 | 0.12 |
| One-shot regressor (trained with off-manifold starts) | 0.865 | 0.37 |
| Flow teacher, 2 ODE steps | 0.894 | 12.86 |
| Flow teacher, 32 ODE steps (exact) | 0.901 | 282.95 |
| **Flow-map student, 1 jump** | 0.905 | 0.41 |
| **Flow-map student, 2 jumps (main)** | 0.906 | 0.84 |
